subject: Pilot credit request — Horizon Labs co-funded trial
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@horizonlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit request & co-fund for Horizon Labs POC

Hi Irene / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Horizon Labs is excited to move forward with a short POC to validate Redwood in a data-product workflow. We have been accepted into the CloudLaunch Accelerator cohort and they have offered a $10k trial stipend, but to make the POC realistic we need an additional $15k in partner credits (Marketplace credits or Redwood promo) to cover higher token volume for evaluation.

Request: could Redwood confirm a partner-sourced credit match for $15,000 (USD equivalent) scoped to the Horizon Labs POC? Key constraints:
- Credits must be usable for our account across the Marketplace listing (or applied at the tenant level if easier)
- Validity window: ~60 days from activation
- We need a short commitment by Aug 10 to hit our accelerator milestone.

Attached: one-pager with POC scope and expected token budget (Horizon_POC_onepager.pdf).

Happy to hop on a quick call this week if helpful.

Best,
Julia Park
Head of ML — Horizon Labs
julia@horizonlabs.com
+1 415 555 0198

Looping in Partner Ops and Finance so we can confirm the formal path. Proposed informal plan from my side:
1) Ben / Partner Ops to confirm whether this can be delivered as Marketplace credits (preferred) or internal promo credits.
2) If Marketplace, we need the PO (or purchase flow) routed to marketplace-ops@amazon.com and a short SOW to attach. If internal promo, Finance will need a credit_request_form + approvals.
3) Marissa / Finance to confirm spend bucket / expiration and whether we need a deal or credit memo.

Ben — can you take point on the technical ops path and tell us expected lead time? If Marketplace routing is longer than a week we should consider awarding a temporary internal promo so Horizon can start on Aug 12 (they requested that date).

Julia — would you be able to circulate a PO template if Marketplace routing is required, or confirm who at AWS Marketplace will own the handoff?

Thanks — taking point. Quick summary of options and recommended path:

1) Marketplace credit (preferred):
   - Pros: applies directly to Horizon's marketplace account and keeps accounting tidy.
   - Cons: AWS Marketplace requires a PO and marketplace review; typical lead time 7–10 business days for entitlements to reflect.
   - Docs needed: PO routed to marketplace-ops@amazon.com, SOW (SOW_draft.pdf), and our internal marketplace onboarding form.

2) Redwood promo credit (fast):
   - Pros: we can provision internal promo credit in ~2 business days; immediate start for the POC.
   - Cons: manual accounting adjustment later, requires finance sign-off.

Recommendation: provision a $15,000 Redwood promo (temp) so Horizon can start on Aug 12, and concurrently submit Marketplace routing so credits can be converted/ported if possible. If Horizon is comfortable, they can route a PO to marketplace-ops@amazon.com and we'll submit the conversion ticket.

Attached is the credit_request_form.xlsx (fill fields highlighted in green): amount, customer marketplace account id, expected activation window, and internal GL code. Marissa — can you 1) confirm GL/approval matrix, 2) sign off on temporary promo for up to 60 days, and 3) confirm whether the promo will require a deal id or invoice memo?

Action items:
- Horizon / Julia: confirm if you can provide a PO by EOD Friday (Aug 7) and the marketplace account id.
- Marissa: finance sign-off on $15k temporary promo and GL routing.
- Irene / Vanessa: confirm go/no-go on Aug 10.

Ben Carter
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: credit_request_form.xlsx
